title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Scheffler on Golf Rivalry
items.text: Scottie Scheffler said his biggest rival is the golf course, not other players, rejecting Rory McIlroy’s personal jabs at Bryson DeChambeau after The Open penalty controversy.

items.headline: Aaron Wise’s Mental Health Comeback
items.text: Aaron Wise revealed depression led to his 2023 Masters withdrawal, but with neuroscientist help and support from his wife, he is now successfully mounting a PGA Tour comeback.
